apps.name: GymM8
apps.subtitle: Track workouts and gym progress
apps.localizedDescription: Plan workouts, record sets, follow progression, and review your gym history.

versions.localizedDescription: Improves Focus set controls with reliable minus/plus taps, smaller consistent decimal values, quarter-step vertical weight adjustment, an adaptive Next Up queue and Back to Next Up. Coach suggestions are centered and dismissible. Rest editing collapses Next Up; upcoming-set editing hides rest controls. Removes horizontal set gestures and numeric scrolling. Compact PR badge beside Previous set. Compatible with Garmin companion 1.3.0.

Redesigned compact Focus layout with full-size decimal weights, clearer Previous set, compact progress and a scrollable Next Up queue. Rest controls and countdown now share the Next Up tile; Last session comparison is removed. Metrics is available only during workouts, with sync controls inside Metrics and a small status dot beside Workout. Reduces Health reading and heart-rate chart rendering work. Compatible with Garmin companion 1.3.0.

Adds a Metrics screen for pulse, calories and heart-rate charts from Garmin or Apple Health. Apple Watch Health readings may be delayed. Pause/resume live syncing in Settings or from the workout sync icon, refresh once while paused and see green/orange/red sync status. Garmin recording continues while paused. Update the Forerunner 970 companion to 1.3.0.

Adds global and exercise-specific weight increments, custom steps and equipment weight lists. Coach suggestions and phone/Garmin adjustments follow your available weights. Reorganizes Settings, restores standard Focus layout and improves Garmin command recovery while the phone is locked. Update the Forerunner 970 companion to 1.2.0 for configured watch weight editing.

Adds Apple Health: optionally save strength workouts, read active calories and heart-rate measurements from Apple Watch and other Health sources, refresh finished workouts, and reuse matching workout records. Enable the options in Settings → Apple Health. For frequent Apple Watch readings, start Strength Training in the watch Workout app.

Adds Garmin set controls, weight/reps editing, vertical navigation, live heart rate, and calories/heart-rate measurements in finished workouts. Update the Forerunner 970 companion to 1.1.0 in Connect IQ. GymM8 saves a Strength activity to Garmin Connect.

Adds a Forerunner 970 companion: current exercise and set display, local rest countdown and alerts, and phone-controlled workout recording. Set up in Settings → Garmin after installing the USB watch app. Opening from the phone requires confirmation on the watch; finishing saves the Garmin recording and abandoning discards it.
Adds complete backup and restore, workout and exercise sharing, improved workout views, split arm and leg tracking, and reliability fixes.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: GymM8 connects to your Garmin to sync workouts, exercise details, and rest timers.
privacy.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: GymM8 connects to your Garmin workout companion.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: GymM8 uses the camera to scan shared exercise QR codes.
privacy.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: GymM8 reads workouts, heart rate and active calories from Apple Health, including Apple Watch measurements, to show your workout statistics and avoid duplicate workouts.
privacy.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: GymM8 saves completed strength workouts and their duration to Apple Health when you enable workout syncing.
